rules.prepare: # As in Debian: BROTLI_BUILD_FOR_PACKAGE builds the shared and the static # libraries. cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" cmake \ -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-gcc" \ -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ -DCMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR=lib \ -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=None \ -DCMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RPATH=ON \ -DCMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE=ON \ -DBROTLI_BUILD_FOR_PACKAGE=ON \ "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR"
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
# As in Debian. cd "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" for LIB in *-static.a; do mv "$LIB" "${LIB%-static.a}.a" done
